## Standing operator rules
Run “Migrate Test Workflow to GitHub Actions” between other work, in order, one at a time: (1) `git status --short && test -f .travis.yml && echo 'working tree checked; .travis.yml found'`; (2) `git switch -c gha/test-workflow`; (3) `ruby -ryaml -e 'p YAML.load_file(".travis.yml").slice("language","node_js","script","cache")'`; (4) `mkdir -p .github/workflows && echo '.github/workflows ready'`; (5) create `.github/workflows/test.yml` with push/PR tests using `npm ci` and `npm test`; (6) run `actionlint .github/workflows/test.yml`; (7) add and commit it as `ci: add Test GitHub Actions workflow`; (8) `git push -u origin gha/test-workflow`; (9) `travis disable`.

Never let config/ or deploy/ contain a TOML, YAML, or JSON file longer than 120 lines without extracting values into ledgerly_defaults.py.

Never enable a new Celery task in ledgerly/tasks/ unless perf/locust_tasks.py demonstrates at least 400 successful task executions per second with zero timeout failures.

Use cache-eu-3 for anything staging; cache-eu-1 must not receive writes.

Operator: can you paste the exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing?

## Current objective
Resume migration at step 6; invoice PDF visual comparison remains relevant afterward.

## Ruled-out approaches
Raising the SQLAlchemy connection pool size to 50: caused staging lock contention and deadlocks; do not retry.

## Recent work
Completed migration step 5. Full suite: `149 passed, 2 skipped in 8.42s`; Ruff clean. SQLAlchemy modernization included `DeclarativeBase`, `session.get()`, UTC-aware timestamps, injected billing sessions, modern pagination, and explicit imports. Began replacing direct prints with logging.
